data.name: Aneen
data.gender_notes: Aneen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aneen is a name of Arabic origin that means grace, delight and pleasure. It is derived from the Arabic word 'an'a which means grace, favor and kindness. This name is often given to girls in the Islamic world and evokes feelings of softness and loveliness. The name Aneen carries the meaning “grace, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aneen usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aneen is a name that is rich in spiritual significance. It is believed to represent the grace and favor of Allah, and is often used to describe the gentle and compassionate nature of those who bear this name. Aneen is also said to symbolize the beauty and elegance of the natural world, and is believed to bring joy and happiness to those who are fortunate enough to bear this name.
data.etymology: Aneen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “grace, pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aneen total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عنين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث و مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني المرحوم، المعطف عليه، و يوحي بالشفقة و الرأفة و الحنان. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: {وَمَا رَضِيَ لَكُم مِّنَ الأَشْيَاءِ حَتَّى يَجْعَلَ الْحُسْنَى وَالإِسَاءَةَ بَينَكُمْ مَّثَلاً مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ وَالْمُسِيءِ كَيفَ تَأْخُذُونَهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ}

in_urdu.name: عنین
in_urdu.meaning: رحم کا محتاج، مہربانی کا طالب
in_urdu.long_meaning: عنین ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رحم کا محتاج یا مہربانی کا طالب۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ شفقت، ہمدردی اور مہربانی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अनीन
in_hindi.meaning: दया का पात्र, करुणा का इच्छुक
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दया का पात्र या करुणा का इच्छुक। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह सहानुभूति, करुणा और दया का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: عنین
in_pashto.meaning: د رحمې وړ, د مړوړې غوښتونکی

historical_references.context: Aneen ibn Qais is mentioned as a chief of the Sons of Kinaanah, an Arab tribe of the Quraysh. He is known for his hospitality to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his people.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari: The History of al-Tabari, Volume 1: The Pre-Islamic Period The name Aneen carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Anas ibn Malik narrates that the Prophet (pbuh) sent a delegation to Anees ibn Malik, chief of the Banu Shayban, to secure an alliance. The Prophet (pbuh) showed kindness to Anees' daughter, Umm Harith, which greatly pleased him.
